title: Everyone merges: each session merges its own PR with the merge tool.
ruling: Owner words, typed in the coordinator's session at 12:58 CST Nov 16 (relayed by the coordinator at 13:07 CST; not read by triage): "No now everyone merges message consultant, ensure it gives you the shpeal, and then spread the message to your lanes". The consultant's text (13:04 CST, relayed to lanes 13:05 CST; triage did not read it): each session merges its own PR with the merge tool (lane, standing, batch runner); lanes no longer hand a finished PR to runner 10. Limits stay: green run of the PR's own head, lane lint PASS, review rounds, record at the live head, merge tool only. Private repos (q_max, degen, home, ios-adblock, joyous) hold until PR #3590 and a setup PR per repo. Whether a lane may mark its own PR ready is settled by decision draft-until-reviewed (owner ruling Q2, 09:44 CST Nov 12, line 7 of the decision, read by triage 13:09 CST): a lane may move its own PR from draft to ready once, after its last review and lane lint, never per push. The coordinator withdrew its question at 13:08 CST (item 922 closed by triage at 13:09 CST, not owner-answered). One conflict stays, for the consultant and coordinator, not the owner. Q2 (09:44 CST Nov 12) says a lane may mark its own PR ready. The standing grant "Lane draft PR" in .claude/CLAUDE.md (owner, 17:19 CST Nov 12, read by triage in its loaded instructions) says only the batch runner marks ready. Decision standing-merge-grant (11:12 CST Nov 15 bullet, coordinator's reading, not read by triage) and the merge tool's guard merge-role-proof (two lanes refused a lane's --ready at about 13:06 CST Nov 16, coordinator's report 13:09 CST, not read by triage) follow the grant. Which text wins: triage does not say. By date the grant is later than Q2, yet it speaks of a lane opening its draft PR, not of Q2's once-after-lint ready. Neither text names the other. Until the consultant rules on the guard, the coordinator's lanes keep the route where runner 10 marks ready and the lane merges on a green run. Triage's own use of it (goal item 6): not taken. Triage merges nothing on a relayed word, and has no open PR of its own that is ready.
